species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 47°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 2–16 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 47°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–18 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
South wind at 8 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
